db_conflicts.research_value: 4 × 4cm (stated verbatim as "size 4x4" by Syria's Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Expatriates, for first-time passport issuance via diplomatic missions abroad)

cross_verification.note_en: This spec was verified via Syria's Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Expatriates (mofaex.gov.sy) official service page for first-time passport issuance for Syrians abroad, listing exact requirements: appointment confirmation, printed application form, personal ID/civil-registry extract with a recent photo (under 6 months) certified by a local Mukhtar, 'two recent colored passport-sized photos with a white background, wearing dark clothing, size 4x4', and a residence-card copy. This is the domestic Immigration and Passports Directorate's likely equivalent for in-country applicants, but this research only confirmed the MOFA (overseas-mission) page; the directorate underwent a major post-2024 transitional-government reform (new green passport design unveiled 3 July 2025) so requirements may differ for in-country applications. Third-party sites cite conflicting sizes (40x60mm, 51x51mm, 4x6cm) that could not be traced to any Syrian government source and are excluded.
